ONE play monetization stays unavailable without game-owned authenticated issuer routes and durable intent, receipt, ledger and encrypted client recovery stores.
SDK player IDs are platform asserted, not authenticated backend identities. Client ad or purchase callbacks never grant.
Require completed consume/acknowledge before accepting PNS; implement atomic cancellation fencing and authoritative revocation in the game ledger.
Keep uncertain native outcomes quarantined; SDK resume is not closure proof. Validate issued IDs, SSV, payments and hosting in the real ONE store app.
